Chapter 15: Toward Collective Liberation—Imagining a New Future.
Our journey? It’s nowhere near finished. The truth is, the challenges are real, and sometimes the way forward feels uncertain. But here’s the thing—there’s real power in letting ourselves imagine something better. Picture a world where Black women are free to be their truest selves, where their voices ring out, and their lives are celebrated.
Imagine this: a group of neighbors gathers in a community center, swapping stories and sharing dreams. They talk about what could be—schools that truly support every child, neighborhoods where everyone feels safe, workplaces that treat people fairly. They let themselves dream about a world where no one’s left behind, where justice isn’t just a word—it’s how we live.
Most people don’t realize just how much change starts with imagination. Having the courage to dream, to hope, to really believe that things can get better—that’s the very first step toward making it real.
What becomes clear is that collective liberation isn’t just this far-off goal—it’s something we work on, together, every day. It means truly listening to each other, learning from our experiences, and joining forces to make a difference. It’s about respecting where we’ve come from, facing the realities of today, and building a future where everyone has the chance to thrive.
